top_verse_en: He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.

refs.t_en: He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, "I am not the Christ."
You yourselves can testify that I said, 'I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.'
Paul explained: "John's baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the One coming after him, that is, in Jesus."

outline.text_en: The divinity, humanity, office, and incarnation of Jesus Christ.
The calling of Simon and Andrew, Philip and Nathanael

parallel_en.text: He was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
